causal_chain: Gateway timeout occurs during a capture attempt.
System automatically retries the capture (timeout retry).
Because idempotency key enforcement is disabled, the retry is sent without an idempotency key.
PSP processes the retry as a new capture (no deduplication).
Order ends with two captures, observed as a double charge in support tickets.

[E-02] shows that during 2026-09-09..10 all duplicate orders had a second capture as a gateway timeout retry lacking an idempotency key; [E-03] shows idempotency key enforcement was disabled on 2026-09-09; [E-04] shows a sharp rise in double‑charge tickets in weeks W37‑W38 coinciding with that period. The correlation is supported by PSP log analysis (E-02) and gateway config audit (E-03); open duplicate orders are observed (E-08) and ticket spikes (E-04) confirm the impact. The release entailed reviewing PSP capture attempt logs to confirm the duplicate‑capture mechanism (work item W-REVIEW-PSP-LOGS).
